purpose: Canonical Relation Set output contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer. This artifact is the single semantic source of truth from which all Hero -> Soldier and Soldier -> Hero indexes must later be derived.

artifact.legacyRule: The legacy stage-3 relation file remains a frozen regression reference and must not be overwritten by A-6.

fields.inputs: exact source snapshot descriptors used to build the relation set
fields.contracts: exact A-1 through A-5 contract descriptors used by the builder
fields.summary: derived counts for regression and auditing; never semantic input
fields.edges: ordered array of canonical A-4 edges; the only semantic relation payload

descriptorShape.gitBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA when generated from repository state; required for frozen/reproducible outputs

inputSnapshotContract.rule: A generated relation set must identify the exact input blobs it used. File names alone are insufficient for a frozen baseline because the contents may change over time.

descriptorShape.gitBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the contract used

contractSnapshotContract.rule: A builder result is reproducible only when both data inputs and semantic contracts are version-pinned.

definitions.heroCount: number of distinct heroId values present in edges
definitions.soldierCount: number of distinct soldierId values present in edges
definitions.edgeCount: number of unique canonical (heroId, soldierId) edges after A-5 union
definitions.provenanceCount: total provenance entries across all canonical edges after provenance deduplication
definitions.sourceProductionCounts: count of provenance entries grouped by sourceKind; may sum to more than edgeCount

summaryContract.semanticRule: summary is derived from edges and must never be used to add, delete, repair or infer an edge.

baselineReference.reason: The golden counts are regression references from the pre-migration snapshot, not permanent game-data constants.

edgeSetContract.uniqueness: No duplicate canonical pairs are allowed.
edgeSetContract.provenance: Every edge must have one or more valid provenance entries.
edgeSetContract.ordering: Serialize by soldierId ascending, then heroId ascending; provenance ordering follows A-4.
edgeSetContract.reason: Names, site IDs, tiers, SP flags and other presentation/classification fields remain owned by the canonical masters and are resolved at read time.

forbiddenParallelSources: reverse indexes treated as new evidence
authorityBoundary.rule: If a derived view disagrees with edges, edges remain authoritative and the derived view is considered stale or invalid.

indexBoundary.rule: A-6 contains only the canonical relation set. byHeroId and bySoldierId structures are specified separately in A-7 and must be generated exclusively from edges.
indexBoundary.reason: Keeping canonical semantics separate from acceleration/index structures prevents duplicated ownership and bidirectional drift.

validationBoundary.publicationRule: A generated relation set must not replace the current accepted baseline or be consumed as production-ready data until the later shared validation stage records PASS.
validationBoundary.invalidReferenceRule: Unknown heroId, unknown soldierId, invalid sourceKind or invalid inheritance provenance must remain validation failures rather than being removed to make the output pass.

compatibleChanges: adding optional non-semantic build metadata outside edges
breakingChanges: embedding presentation metadata as semantic edge fields
versioningRules.breakingChangeAction: Create a new contract/artifact major version instead of silently changing v1 semantics.

completion: A-6 is complete when the shared relation layer has one formally defined canonical output artifact whose only semantic payload is the provenance-bearing canonical edge set, with exact input/contract snapshot traceability and no embedded bidirectional indexes.
